This task doesn't require deep Minecraft domain knowledge (no crafting recipes or complex mechanics), just exploration and object recognition. It's straightforward to set up in a scene and verify completion through proximity or line-of-sight detection.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the oak structure and visually locate the yellow bed inside. Target is the bed's foot position at spawn-relative (10, 1, 10), matching the /setblock ~10 ~1 ~10 command. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to have genuinely found the bed (inside the structure or at the doorway, which is ~2 blocks from the bed). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the bed, not just standing nearby facing away. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because find tasks should verify the player can see the target, not just that they reached a location.

scene_description: A flat grassy area with three small structures: an oak plank house containing a yellow bed (the target), a cobblestone shed with a crafting table (distractor), and a spruce plank hut with a chest (distractor). Torches mark paths, and a cow and pig provide ambient life. The player spawns at the center and must explore to find the yellow bed inside the oak structure ~10 blocks to the north-east.
task_text: Find the yellow bed. Explore the area, locate the structure containing a yellow bed, and walk up to it.
design_notes: Yellow bed is at relative (~10, ~1, ~9-10) inside a 5x5x5 oak plank structure with a 1x3 doorway on the south face (z=8 side). The bed faces north. Two distractor structures (cobblestone at ~-5,~-5 and spruce at ~3,~-8) provide exploration variety. Area is cleared of natural trees for ~15 blocks in all directions. Torches guide the player.
